leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a basic Express server to handle HTTP requests
Configure route handlers to intercept incoming API calls
Implement HTTP client functionality to forward requests to backend services
Manipulate request headers and parameters before proxying
Integrate response transformation logic for unified client output
Initialize error handling for failed proxy requests
Apply middleware to log proxy activities and monitor traffic
lessonTitle: Build API gateway like proxy endpoint
